name: Bordly Command Wise Admin
author: Chintan Soni

sections.description:
Bordly Command Wise Admin is a WordPress admin command center that gives site administrators, developers, agencies, and site owners a faster way to manage WordPress from a chat-style interface.

Instead of navigating through multiple WordPress admin screens, you can type natural-language commands to perform supported tasks across your website. Commands are organized into modules and are available only when the required WordPress feature or supported plugin is active.

WordPress admin features include:

  • Pages, Posts, and registered Custom Post Types
  • Media Library management
  • Users and comments
  • Navigation Menus
  • Site performance tools
  • Developer tools and database maintenance
  • Security checks
  • Favorites and recent commands
  • Saved multi-step workflows
  • Command history and logs
  • Confirmation protection for potentially destructive actions

Plugin-aware integrations

Commands for the following integrations appear only when the related plugin is installed and active:

  • WooCommerce — manage supported WooCommerce store and product-related admin tasks.
  • Advanced Custom Fields — work with supported ACF fields, field groups, and content-management tasks.
  • Rank Math SEO — access supported SEO and Rank Math administration commands.
  • Contact Form 7 — manage supported Contact Form 7 administration tasks.
  • ImagePilot Featured Images — access supported featured-image workflow commands.
  • ACF Flexible Layout Preview — manage supported ACF Flexible Content layout preview commands.
  • BoundaryGuard Headers — manage supported HTTP security header and CSP-related commands.

The plugin does not require these integrations for its core functionality. If an integration is not active, its related command module remains unavailable.

Built for WordPress administrators and developers

Bordly Command Wise Admin is designed for WordPress websites where administrators need quick access to common backend tasks without repeatedly navigating through different dashboard screens. It can be useful for agencies, developers, content teams, WooCommerce store managers, and site administrators.

Command safety

Every command runs through WordPress capability checks. Commands that may change or delete data can require explicit confirmation before execution, helping reduce accidental destructive actions.

External services

This plugin does not send any of your data to an external server, and it does not make any network requests to third-party services.

The optional “BoundaryGuard Headers” command group (only shown if that separate plugin is active) lets you fill in Content-Security-Policy source lists using one-click presets for common third-party services. These preset values are static strings bundled in this plugin’s code, mirroring BoundaryGuard Headers’ built-in presets. Selecting a preset only writes a domain name into a CSP setting on your own WordPress site. This plugin itself never contacts those domains and never sends them any data.

Privacy

Bordly Command Wise Admin is designed to operate within your WordPress installation. It does not transmit your WordPress site data to an external server and does not require a third-party account or remote API for its core command functionality.

Security

Commands respect standard WordPress capability checks. Potentially destructive operations can require explicit confirmation before they are executed.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the bordly-command-wise-admin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip directly from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Bordly Command Wise in the wp-admin menu to open the Command Center.
  4. Open Bordly Command Wise > Settings > Command Modules to configure available command groups.
sections.faq:
What is Bordly Command Wise Admin?

Bordly Command Wise Admin is a WordPress admin command center that lets you manage supported WordPress tasks using natural-language commands from a chat-style dashboard.

Does this work without any other plugins installed?

Yes. Core commands for pages, posts, media, users, comments, menus, performance, developer tools, database maintenance, and security work without the optional integrations. Plugin-aware command groups are enabled only when their corresponding supported plugin is installed and active.

Which plugins does Bordly Command Wise Admin integrate with?

Supported plugin-aware integrations include WooCommerce, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), Rank Math SEO, Contact Form 7, ImagePilot Featured Images, ACF Flexible Layout Preview, and BoundaryGuard Headers.

Can I turn off command groups I don’t use?

Yes. Go to Bordly Command Wise > Settings > Command Modules to enable or disable supported command groups.

Does it require confirmation before deleting things?

By default, potentially destructive commands such as delete, remove, trash, or permanent-delete actions can require explicit confirmation. You can manage this behavior under Settings > Command Safety.

Does it replace the WordPress dashboard?

No. Bordly Command Wise Admin adds a command-based management interface inside wp-admin. Standard WordPress administration screens remain available.

Does it send my WordPress data to an external server?

No. The plugin does not send your site data to an external server and does not make network requests to third-party services.
